items.canonical_h2: 何时不需要 Agent
items.actual_h2: 何时不需要 Agent
items.prior_post_write_finding: The platform chapter evolves transcript-only recovery into a turn-boundary commit over conversation, filesystem, process, tool receipt and runtime identity. Sparse detection remains only a proposal; false negatives, co-location contention, restore consistency and conservative checkpoint fallback are explicit without duplicating workflow ownership.
items.evidence_boundary: §9 Conclusion — exact-v1 has no dedicated limitations section; evidence is confined to Linux sandbox workloads and evaluated C/R backends

current_content_replay.owner_responsibility: Ch84 owns AgentRun/workspace lifecycle and the cross-object recovery point over conversation, filesystem, process, tool receipt, and runtime identity.

items.actual_h2: 能力生产与能力交付不能互相替代

items.evidence_boundary: §7 Conclusion — exact-v1 has no dedicated limitations section; scenario assumptions and cost model are not universal production measurements

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.actual_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.prior_post_write_finding: Evaluation now uses a versioned endpoint/model configuration rather than a model name and binds workload, quality, energy, latency, price, failure rate and evaluator identity. Provider drift and opaque fields bound the claim to the observed configuration and time window; cost remains a measured dimension rather than a second owner.
items.evidence_boundary: §6 discussion and limitations on provider drift, observability and evaluator scope

current_content_replay.owner_responsibility: Ch66 owns the versioned evaluation object and binds endpoint/model configuration, workload, quality, energy, latency, price, failure rate, evaluator, and observation window.
current_content_replay.adjacent_responsibility: Ch56 consumes calibrated evaluation evidence to commit routing and placement; Ch70 owns resource-time and outcome-based cost attribution.
current_content_replay.semantic_replay: No semantic duplicate. Scheduling does not own evaluation identity, and Cost does not own comparative quality or provider-drift conclusions; both remain downstream consumers of the Ch66 contract.

items.canonical_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.actual_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.prior_post_write_finding: Skill audit moves from prose inspection to a finite fact base and deterministic source-to-sink/permission/effect checks. Abstraction incompleteness and dynamic behavior are explicit failure modes, and runtime effect authorization remains the final owner rather than static Datalog approval.
items.evidence_boundary: §7 Conclusion — exact-v1 has no dedicated limitations section; static abstraction cannot prove dynamic runtime safety

items.canonical_h2: Freshness、Deletion 与 Consistency
items.actual_h2: Freshness、Deletion 与 Consistency
items.prior_post_write_finding: Static passage ranking remains the simple branch; changing corpora require an atomic retrieval object with provenance, validity, conflict and lifecycle state before ranking. Extraction and invalidation costs plus passage-level fallback are explicit, while durable memory remains in the next chapter.
items.evidence_boundary: §6/§7 selected QA corpora and author metrics do not prove a universal source-authority policy

items.canonical_h2: Evaluation
items.actual_h2: Evaluation
items.prior_post_write_finding: Delegation degree becomes explicit runtime control only when task and risk evolve; fixed topology remains the auditable fallback. The controller proposes utility/safety trade-offs, while external capability scope, responsibility propagation and effect receipts retain commit authority; formal feasibility is not presented as deployed evidence.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: exact-v1 explicitly leaves empirical validation to future work; formal assumptions do not prove deployable runtime safety

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.actual_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.prior_post_write_finding: Aggregate deltas are preserved as a coarse comparison, but release authority now consumes repeat sampling, reliable-change intervals, sampling variance and harmed/helped churn. The prose explicitly rejects a universal threshold across model families or benchmarks.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: two families and one benchmark do not calibrate a universal RCI threshold or production consequence

items.canonical_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.actual_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.prior_post_write_finding: The chapter correctly moves the privacy boundary ahead of dataset mounting because repository loaders and dependencies execute first. The attack is bounded as a demonstrated possibility, and disabling remote code, a fixed runtime and a read-only minimal data plane remain explicit fallbacks.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: demonstrated attacks do not establish ecosystem prevalence; controls depend on the actual loader/runtime boundary

items.canonical_h2: 能力生产与能力交付不能互相替代
items.actual_h2: 能力生产与能力交付不能互相替代
items.prior_post_write_finding: Escalation is modeled as a partially observed scheduling decision updated by verifiable observations, expected reliability gain, cost and stopping budget. Self-reported confidence has no commit authority; uncalibrated or drifting verifiers trigger strong-path or human fallback.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: proxy-verifier calibration and workload stationarity limit generalization to unseen services

items.canonical_h2: 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph
items.actual_h2: 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph
items.prior_post_write_finding: Contamination provenance is extended through artifact transformations and workflow edges to the first control-flow divergence. Trace completeness and synthetic corruption bound the evidence, and the prose explicitly forbids causal attribution without intervention.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: synthetic workflows and chosen corruption models do not quantify real-world prevalence or causal completeness

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.actual_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.prior_post_write_finding: Prompt interface is made part of evaluation identity, separating frozen common-prompt comparability from per-model optimized deployment capability. The text exposes hidden search budget and prevents prompt mismatch from being attributed to weights; both contracts coexist rather than one replacing the other.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: selected optimizers, tasks and search budgets do not define a universally fair evaluation regime

items.canonical_h2: Observability
items.actual_h2: Observability
items.prior_post_write_finding: MCP security evolves from per-tool permission to cross-server information-flow identity carrying principal, server and taint. Synthetic canaries do not prove non-interference; incomplete evidence falls back to isolation or human effect authorization, preserving the platform security owner.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: synthetic canaries and enumerated servers do not prove complete semantic non-interference

items.canonical_h2: ROI 的边界
items.actual_h2: ROI 的边界
items.prior_post_write_finding: Energy geography is constrained after state locality, capacity, latency, regulation and failure domains, so price or carbon intensity never gains routing authority alone. Analytical what-if is separated from production trace and fixed-region placement remains the non-relocatable fallback.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: analytical inputs and assumed relocatability are not measured production traces or universal grid emissions

items.canonical_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.actual_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.prior_post_write_finding: Reward hypotheses fork from a shared checkpoint, pass competence-aware verification and enter phase-aware limited deployment. Branch-training cost and specification gaming are explicit, with fixed or human-designed rewards retained when verification is insufficient.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: selected environments and verifier signals do not prove reward correctness or prevent all specification gaming

items.canonical_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.actual_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.prior_post_write_finding: The SFT-to-RLVR handoff is no longer assumed neutral; black-box on-policy distillation is a conditional bridge when policy distribution leaves the verifiable region. Teacher cost and imitation bias are explicit, while direct handoff remains the simpler branch without material drift or teacher access.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: selected models/tasks and teacher access do not establish universal benefit or cost efficiency

items.canonical_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.actual_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.prior_post_write_finding: Residual-activation trajectory probes are correctly framed as versioned white-box sensors, not authorization. Recalibration, hosted-model inapplicability and output/tool/effect fallback controls keep the empirical signal inside its evidence boundary.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: white-box activations and model-specific probes limit hosted-model use and require recalibration after updates

items.canonical_h2: 能力生产与能力交付不能互相替代
items.actual_h2: 能力生产与能力交付不能互相替代
items.prior_post_write_finding: Priority is evolved beyond queue order into interference-conditioned latency state keyed by co-runner, batch shape and hardware revision. Predictor failure falls back to isolation or conservative concurrency, and SLO evidence retains final commit authority.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: on-premises model roster and hardware do not establish universal predictor transfer or tail-SLO behavior

items.canonical_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.actual_h2: Evaluation 必须独立于 Reward Model
items.prior_post_write_finding: Exploration is promoted to a training trust boundary with rollout diversity, action coverage, update magnitude and task progress as diagnostic evidence. Constructed experiments are not generalized to intent or prevalence, so the metrics remain sensors rather than verdicts.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: constructed settings do not establish spontaneous prevalence in deployed models or a complete detector

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践
items.actual_h2: 工程实践
items.prior_post_write_finding: Fréchet distance evolves from post-training evaluation to a bounded distribution-matching objective only after population statistics are decoupled from gradient batches. Estimator state, encoder bias, modality limits and likelihood/task-loss coexistence are explicit.
items.evidence_boundary: Not Disclosed — exact-v1 has no dedicated Limitations heading; bounded non-proof: selected representation encoders and image workloads do not prove perceptual alignment or generalization to all modalities

items.canonical_h2: Testing 与 Evaluation
items.actual_h2: Testing 与 Evaluation
items.prior_post_write_finding: In-context self-routing is integrated as a conditional branch for short, context-contained, low-effect procedures. Token cost and weak recovery are traded for a simpler control plane; durable external workflow state remains required for long runs, events, irreversible effects, audit and restart.
items.evidence_boundary: §5.2-5.3 three simulated customer-service domains, LLM judges and frontier-model capability bound the conclusion; token cost is higher in-context

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.actual_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.prior_post_write_finding: Code-agent verifier infrastructure is made part of reward truth through judge synthesis, parallel tests, multi-node sandbox, versioned suite and failure replay. Generated judges and finite sandbox/task coverage explicitly prevent a passing run from proving arbitrary-program correctness.
items.evidence_boundary: §7 Limitations: generated judges, selected code tasks, sandbox policies and author infrastructure do not prove arbitrary-program correctness or universal RL stability

items.canonical_h2: Trade-off
items.actual_h2: Trade-off
items.prior_post_write_finding: Binary lifting is written as typed-state and control-flow recovery rather than textual translation. Conflicts and unsupported instructions fail closed; typed IR supports audit/migration but native validation remains because architecture, MUFU/texture and full SIMT semantics bound the evidence.
items.evidence_boundary: §6 evaluation cannot validate MUFU, texture or full SIMT behavior through an x86 backend; supported architectures/instructions bound correctness and require fail-closed handling

items.canonical_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.actual_h2: 工程实践：从最小可信闭环开始
items.prior_post_write_finding: Simulator evaluation separates behavioral realism from tester reliability while sharing canonical session identity and loss accounting. Finite languages, populations and simulator families bound transfer, and the two potentially conflicting contracts are reported separately rather than collapsed.
items.evidence_boundary: §8 Limitations: dataset/language/simulator coverage is finite; correlations do not prove causal transfer to production users or unseen retrieval systems
